title: Last Rites
summary: The Haddows paid a priest to say their names once a year, under their chantry, until the money ran out. Hold their crypt while a cleric of yours says them, and Sister Ilse will teach your clerics a blessing.

steps.journal: Go to the Haddow Crypt, under the chantry in the meadow east of the lumber camp, and hold it for five waves while the names are said.

objectives.label: Waves held in the Haddow Crypt

ready: Go back to Sister Ilse at the Shrine of the Ember in Thornwick.
done: Ilse taught your clerics Bless: the rites said forward, for the living, which she says is the only direction that helps.
